stories.title: APURAÇÃO EM TEMPO REAL: mais de 40% das urnas apuradas na BA; Jerônimo tem 53% e Neto, 46%

en.title: REAL-TIME COUNT: over 40% of ballot boxes counted in BA; Jerônimo has 53% and Neto, 46%
en.summary: Vote counting is underway in Bahia with over 40% of ballot boxes tallied. Jerônimo leads with 53% of votes while Neto has 46%.

stories.title: Dorinha (União) e Vicentinho (PSDB) vão para o 2º turno no Tocantins

en.title: Dorinha (União) and Vicentinho (PSDB) advance to second round in Tocantins
en.summary: Dorinha and Vicentinho qualified for the October 25 runoff election for Tocantins governor after the first round. Dorinha secured 45.75% of valid votes while Vicentinho received 43.72%.

stories.title: Quem é Lucas Ribeiro, governador reeleito da Paraíba

en.title: Who is Lucas Ribeiro, reelected governor of Paraíba
en.summary: Lucas Ribeiro was reelected as governor of Paraíba.

stories.title: Renata/Lívia - Brasileiros vão às urnas neste domingo para o primeiro turno das eleições {{Ao Vivo - Minuto}}

en.title: Renata/Lívia - Brazilians go to the polls this Sunday for the first round of elections {{Live - Minute by Minute}}
en.summary: Brazilians are voting in the first round of elections on Sunday.

stories.title: Flávio Bolsonaro e Lula estão no 2º turno, projeta Datafolha

en.title: Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula are in the runoff, Datafolha projects
en.summary: Based on 55.6% of votes counted, polling institute Datafolha projects that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro will face President Lula in the runoff election scheduled for April 25.

stories.title: EDUARDO RIEDEL É REELEITO GOVERNADOR DE MATO GROSSO DO SUL

en.title: EDUARDO RIEDEL IS REELECTED GOVERNOR OF MATO GROSSO DO SUL
en.summary: Eduardo Riedel was reelected as governor of Mato Grosso do Sul in Sunday's election.

stories.title: Eleições 2026: 1º turno tem detidos por boca de urna, troca de urnas e chuva em cidades do interior de SP

en.title: 2026 Elections: first round has detentions for exit poll infractions, ballot box changes and rain in interior cities of SP
en.summary: Sunday's first round of voting saw several irregularities including arrests related to exit polls, replacement of voting machines, and heavy rain in interior São Paulo cities.

stories.title: Primeiro turno das eleições teve 1.861 urnas eletrônicas substituídas

en.title: First round of elections had 1,861 electronic ballot boxes replaced
en.summary: The Superior Electoral Court reported that 1,861 electronic voting machines were replaced during Sunday's first round of voting.

stories.title: Eduardo Riedel é eleito governador de MS no primeiro turno

en.title: Eduardo Riedel is elected governor of MS in the first round
en.summary: Eduardo Riedel of the PP party won the governorship of Mato Grosso do Sul in Brazil's 2026 election, securing 67.36% of valid votes. He defeated PT candidate Fábio Trad, who received 23% of the vote.

stories.title: Eduardo Riedel (PP) é reeleito governador de Mato Grosso do Sul

en.title: Eduardo Riedel (PP) is reelected governor of Mato Grosso do Sul
en.summary: Eduardo Riedel, 57, of the PP party was reelected to serve as governor of Mato Grosso do Sul for the next four years, according to polling projections.

stories.title: Sobe para 1.543 número de urnas substituídas no primeiro turno

en.title: Number of replaced voting machines rises to 1,543 in the first round
en.summary: Brazil's electoral authority reported that 1,543 electronic voting machines were replaced by 3:30 PM on election day, representing 0.28% of all machines used nationwide.

stories.title: Com mais de 47% das urnas apuradas, Flávio Bolsonaro aparece à frente de Lula

en.title: With more than 47% of voting machines counted, Flávio Bolsonaro appears ahead of Lula
en.summary: Preliminary election results with over 47% of voting machines tallied show Flávio Bolsonaro leading Lula in the race.

stories.title: Com 19% das urnas apuradas, Renan Filho (MDB) lidera a disputa ao governo em Alagoas

en.title: With 19% of ballot boxes counted, Renan Filho (MDB) leads gubernatorial race in Alagoas
en.summary: Renan Filho holds 52% support in early results from Alagoas governor election, leading rival João Henrique Caldas who has 47.6% with nearly one-fifth of votes tallied.

stories.title: Apuração: Com 82,86% das urnas, Mailza Assis (PP) lidera disputa pelo governo do Acre com 49,32% dos votos

en.title: Count: With 82.86% of ballot boxes tallied, Mailza Assis (PP) leads Acre gubernatorial race with 49.32% of votes
en.summary: Governor Mailza Assis maintains a lead in Acre with 49.32% support in election results that are over 80% counted, ahead of Alan Rick with 31.83%.

stories.title: Apuração: Em Sergipe, Fábio tem 59% e Valmir de Francisquinho, 37%, com 53% das urnas

en.title: Count: In Sergipe, Fábio has 59% and Valmir de Francisquinho 37%, with 53% of ballot boxes counted
en.summary: Fábio Mitidieri leads the Sergipe gubernatorial election with 59.13% of valid votes against Valmir de Francisquinho's 36.91% in results from about half the ballot boxes.

stories.title: Apuração: Com 27,43% das urnas apuradas, atual governador Jorginho Mello (PL) lidera com 63,77%

en.title: Count: With 27.43% of ballot boxes counted, current governor Jorginho Mello (PL) leads with 63.77%
en.summary: Incumbent governor Jorginho Mello holds a substantial lead in Santa Catarina with 63.77% support over Gelson Merísio's 18.81% in partial election results.

stories.title: Apuração: Com 12% das urnas apuradas no Ceará, Elmano lidera com 51% e Ciro tem 48%

en.title: Count: With 12% of ballots counted in Ceará, Elmano leads with 51% and Ciro has 48%
en.summary: Early ballot counting in Ceará's gubernatorial election shows incumbent Elmano de Freitas leading with 51 percent support compared to 48 percent for former governor Ciro Gomes, based on approximately 12 percent of votes tallied.
